deployments.note: Paper only: reads Market Recorder's live socket on the same machine and writes simulated quotes, fills, position and PnL. No exchange credentials, no orders.

settings.label: Half-spread (bps of the mid)
settings.help: Each simulated quote sits this far from the mid.

settings.label: Inventory skew (bps at full position)
settings.help: Both quotes move this far against the position when it is at the limit, and in proportion below it.

settings.label: Requote threshold (bps)
settings.help: A quote is replaced when its target has moved more than this.

settings.label: Daily loss limit (USD, UTC day)
settings.help: At this loss it flattens and stops. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: Pull quotes when the feed is silent for (s)
Last Stop (set by the page's Stop button)
settings.help: Unix seconds. Use the app's Stop and Resume buttons instead of typing here.

settings.label: Last Resume (set by the page's Resume button)
